_comment: External-evidence layer for evidence-network.html. Anchors OUTSIDE the 184-study ledger that calibrate the rating scales or corroborate family verdicts with live/out-of-scope evidence. Every claim is grounded in evidence-formula-analysis.md (which is itself grounded in a 10-agent web fan-out). The `verified` field carries provenance through per the analysis doc's own caveats: "fetched" = retrieved to source; "snippet" = search-result text only, a lead not a settled fact. Consumed by bake_evidence_network.py; connections are drawn as a distinct external layer. NOTE 2026-07-14: family_flags corrected after a blind rule search + real-market-data validation — reit-vol's over-grade flag was WITHDRAWN (I=3 clears the validated gate) and crypto-vol's basis was restated as a labeling contradiction. See real-data-findings.md.

externals.label: McLean & Pontiff (2016)
externals.claim: 97 published predictors decay ~26% out-of-sample and ~58% post-publication — but not to zero.
externals.role: Calibrates the map's temporal-stability (T) scale: 58% partial decay is literally the T=2 definition, which is why re-validated value/momentum stay at T=3 (Supported) rather than folding into Ineffective.

externals.label: Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016)
externals.claim: 316 factors; with multiple-testing control a new factor needs t > 3, not 2.
externals.role: Is the map's bias-resistance (B) scale: B=1 is the single-test t~2 winner HLZ reject; B=3 is a dependence-aware correction (HLZ's framework).

externals.label: Hou, Xue & Zhang (2020)
externals.claim: 65% of 452 anomalies fail |t|>1.96 once microcaps are controlled (82% fail at t>2.78).
externals.role: Grounds the Ineffective verdicts on the equity anomaly zoo and size once market-cap weighting is applied.

externals.label: Jensen, Kelly & Pedersen (2023)
externals.claim: The lenient pole: 82.4% of factors replicate as CAPM alphas across 93 countries.
externals.role: Licenses the R/T scores of exactly the three equity families rated Supported for alpha — the map cites it as the upper bound.

externals.label: Chen & Zimmermann (2022)
externals.claim: 98% of predictors numerically reproduce; publication bias shrinks returns only 10-15%.
externals.role: Empirical basis for the map's core axiom — numerical reproduction (R) is not economic replication (E): a family can be R=3 and still Ineffective on E. The 98%-reproduce vs 65%-fail contrast against HXZ is the whole point.

externals.label: Basel VaR traffic-light
externals.claim: A standing, regulator-audited daily live backtest across every large bank; ~1% design coverage held everywhere except the March-2020 tail.
externals.role: The closest thing to LIVE-X evidence anywhere in the map — volatility/VaR forecasting is corroborated by 25+ years of mandatory live backtesting the paper ledger cannot capture.

externals.label: S&P / Moody's / Altman-Z live
externals.claim: 40+ years of published live discrimination: S&P one-year Gini 82.6% (1981-2023); Moody's EDF-X flags 87% of defaulters a month out (2004-2020); Altman Z ~80-90% accurate 50 years on.
externals.role: Risk ranking shows no McLean-Pontiff decay — unlike alpha. Corroborates the credit-default-hazard verdict on a live sample, which is why E=0 (no trading alpha) does not sink it.

externals.label: SG Trend / AQMIX (managed futures)
externals.claim: 26 years net-of-fee live: SG Trend CAGR ~4.9%, Sharpe ~0.6; crisis alpha +20.9% in 2008, +27.3% in 2022; AQMIX ~4.1%/yr since 2010 — with a real, cyclical 'lost decade' ~1.8%/yr in the 2010s.
externals.role: Live corroboration of time-series trend beyond the academic ledger, including its documented cyclicality.

externals.label: MSCI Momentum / MTUM live
externals.claim: Live 10-yr momentum premium ~+2pp/yr (MTUM ~16.25%/yr) — positive but a measurable haircut; AQR's AMOMX lagged its benchmark. Beats the 73% backtest-to-live Sharpe haircut and the ~0% 'Smart-Beta Mirage' base rates.
externals.role: Live evidence tempers cross-sectional momentum: real premium, but with a haircut the backtest scores don't show.

externals.label: Russell Value–Growth live spread
externals.claim: The live Value-minus-Growth spread is ~zero/negative over 46 years.
externals.role: For equity value, 'Supported pre-live' is accurate, not conservative — the live record does not corroborate a tradable premium.

family_flags.note: Rated 'Supported pre-live' on scorecard P3 E2 R2 T2 I2 B2 (conf C) — bit-identical to eq-ml-xs and credit-spread-value, which are both rated 'Promising'. Identical scorecards with different verdicts is a contradiction in the data: no score-based rule can separate them, which is why 46/47 is the provable ceiling for any such rule. Supersedes the earlier 'violates min(R,T,B)>=3' framing — that gate was itself mis-derived (it scores 44/47, and its stated carve-outs are logical no-ops). Recommend re-verdict to Promising or document why an identical scorecard earns a higher verdict.
